name: Adam
summary: The first man, formed from the dust and given the breath of life. Placed in Eden, he and Eve disobeyed God's command, bringing sin and death into the world.

name: Eve
summary: The first woman, created as a partner for Adam and called 'the mother of all living.'

name: Cain
summary: Firstborn of Adam and Eve, a farmer who killed his brother Abel out of jealousy and was sent away as a wanderer.

name: Abel
summary: A shepherd whose offering God accepted; murdered by Cain. Hebrews remembers him as the first example of faith.

name: Seth
summary: Born after Abel's death; his line leads to Noah. In his days 'people began to call on the name of the LORD.'

name: Enoch
summary: Seventh from Adam, he 'walked with God, and he was not, for God took him.'

name: Methuselah
summary: The longest-lived person in the Bible (969 years); grandfather of Noah.

name: Lamech
summary: Father of Noah (not the Lamech of Cain's line). He named his son hoping he would bring comfort from the toil of the cursed ground.

name: Noah
summary: A righteous man who built the ark at God's command, preserving his family and the animals through the Flood. God then made a covenant with him, sealed by the rainbow.

name: Shem
summary: Eldest son of Noah, ancestor of the Semitic peoples and of Abraham.

name: Ham
summary: Son of Noah, ancestor of the peoples of Cush, Egypt, Put and Canaan in the Table of Nations.

name: Japheth
summary: Son of Noah whose descendants (Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan…) spread to the coastlands and the north.

name: Terah
summary: Father of Abram, Nahor and Haran. He led his family from Ur of the Chaldeans toward Canaan but settled in Haran.

name: Abraham
summary: Called by God to leave Ur for Canaan, Abraham received the covenant promise of land, descendants, and blessing for all nations. He is honoured as the father of faith by Jews, Christians and Muslims.

name: Sarah
summary: Abraham's wife, who laughed at the promise of a son in old age and bore Isaac at ninety.

name: Hagar
summary: Sarah's Egyptian servant and mother of Ishmael. In the wilderness she named God 'the God who sees me.'

name: Ishmael
summary: Abraham's firstborn son, through Hagar. God promised to make him a great nation.

name: Haran
summary: Abraham's brother, who died in Ur; father of Lot.

name: Lot
summary: Abraham's nephew, who settled near Sodom and was rescued before its destruction.

name: Isaac
summary: The child of promise, born to Abraham and Sarah in their old age. Nearly sacrificed on Mount Moriah, he married Rebekah and became father of Esau and Jacob.

name: Rebekah
summary: Chosen at the well as Isaac's wife; mother of the twins Esau and Jacob. She helped Jacob obtain Isaac's blessing.

name: Esau
summary: Jacob's twin, a hunter who sold his birthright for a meal; ancestor of the Edomites.

name: Jacob
meaning: supplanter; later 'Israel', he strives with God
summary: Grandson of Abraham who obtained the birthright and blessing, dreamed of a stairway to heaven, wrestled with God and was renamed Israel. His twelve sons became the tribes of Israel.

name: Leah
summary: Jacob's first wife and mother of six tribes, including Levi and Judah: the priestly and royal lines.

name: Rachel
summary: Jacob's beloved wife and mother of Joseph and Benjamin. She died giving birth to Benjamin near Bethlehem.

name: Levi
summary: Third son of Jacob and Leah. His descendants, the Levites, became Israel's priestly tribe, including Moses and Aaron.

name: Judah
summary: Fourth son of Jacob and Leah. He offered himself in Benjamin's place, and Jacob foretold that the sceptre would not depart from Judah: the line of David and of Jesus.

name: Tamar
summary: Judah's daughter-in-law, who secured her rights through Judah himself. Mother of the twins Perez and Zerah, she is named in Jesus' genealogy.

name: Joseph
summary: Jacob's favoured son, sold into slavery by his brothers. He rose to rule Egypt under Pharaoh, saved his family from famine and forgave his brothers.

references.label: You meant evil; God meant good

name: Benjamin
summary: Jacob's youngest son and Rachel's second child; ancestor of King Saul and the apostle Paul.

references.label: Paul, of the tribe of Benjamin

name: Perez
summary: Son of Judah and Tamar; ancestor of Boaz and David.

name: Amram
summary: A Levite, husband of Jochebed and father of Aaron, Moses and Miriam.

name: Jochebed
summary: Mother of Moses. She hid him for three months, then placed him in a basket on the Nile.

name: Miriam
summary: A prophetess and the sister of Moses, who led the women in song after the crossing of the sea.

name: Aaron
summary: Moses' older brother and spokesman, and Israel's first high priest. He made the golden calf, but God confirmed his priesthood when his staff budded.

name: Moses
summary: Born a Hebrew in Egypt and raised in Pharaoh's household, Moses met God at the burning bush, led Israel out of slavery and received the Law at Sinai. He died within sight of the Promised Land.

name: Boaz
summary: A wealthy man of Bethlehem who married Ruth as kinsman-redeemer; great-grandfather of David.

name: Ruth
summary: A Moabite widow who stayed with her mother-in-law Naomi ('where you go I will go'), married Boaz and became David's great-grandmother.

references.label: Where you go, I will go

name: Obed
summary: Son of Boaz and Ruth; father of Jesse.

name: Jesse
summary: A Bethlehemite, father of David. The 'stump of Jesse' became an image of the coming Messiah.

references.label: A shoot from the stump of Jesse

name: Saul
summary: Israel's first king, a Benjamite anointed by Samuel. He disobeyed God, was rejected, and died in battle against the Philistines on Mount Gilboa.

name: Jonathan
summary: Saul's son and David's loyal friend; killed with his father on Mount Gilboa.

name: David
summary: The shepherd who defeated Goliath, became Israel's greatest king and made Jerusalem his capital. God promised him an everlasting dynasty, and many psalms are attributed to him.

name: Bathsheba
summary: Wife of Uriah, taken by David. She later became queen mother and secured the throne for her son Solomon.

name: Solomon
summary: Son of David and Bathsheba, famed for wisdom and wealth; he built the First Temple in Jerusalem. His foreign wives turned his heart from God, and the kingdom split after his death.

name: Rehoboam
summary: Solomon's son. His harsh answer to the people caused the ten northern tribes to break away, and he became the first king of Judah.

name: Jeroboam I
summary: An Ephraimite official who became the first king of the northern kingdom of Israel and set up golden calves at Bethel and Dan.

name: Hezekiah
summary: A reforming king of Judah who trusted God when the Assyrian army besieged Jerusalem; the prophet Isaiah was his counsellor.

name: Josiah
summary: Became king at eight. When the Book of the Law was found in the Temple, he led Judah's greatest reform. He was killed at Megiddo.

references.label: The Book of the Law found

name: Zerubbabel
summary: Grandson of King Jehoiachin and governor of Judah, who led returning exiles and rebuilt the Temple, encouraged by Haggai and Zechariah.

references.label: Not by might, but by my Spirit

name: Herod the Great
summary: Roman client king of Judea and builder of the great Temple expansion; he ordered the massacre of Bethlehem's infants.

name: Herod Antipas
summary: Son of Herod the Great and tetrarch of Galilee. He had John the Baptist beheaded and questioned Jesus during his trial.

name: Joseph of Nazareth
summary: A carpenter descended from David and betrothed to Mary. Warned in dreams, he took Mary as his wife and protected the child Jesus.

references.label: The boy Jesus in the Temple

name: Mary
summary: A young woman of Nazareth to whom the angel Gabriel announced she would bear the Son of God. She stood at the cross and was with the early church.

name: Jesus
summary: Born in Bethlehem and raised in Nazareth, Jesus proclaimed the kingdom of God, taught and healed, was crucified in Jerusalem and, according to the Gospels, rose from the dead. Matthew and Luke trace his genealogy through David to Abraham and Adam.
